guideImpact.affectedSection: GIS layer Display Settings — Show linked sites
guideImpact.reason: The delivered behavior includes a user-facing Show linked sites control in Display Settings whose checked state can be changed and restored for a loaded Surveyor layer. The guide should explain where to find this control and how its state behaves when settings are reopened.

guideUpdate.title: Restore Show linked sites after two changes in V4 GIS
guideUpdate.affectedSection: GIS layer Display Settings — Show linked sites
steps: Open Display Settings for a loaded Surveyor layer.
Select Show linked sites to check or uncheck it.
Select Show linked sites again to restore the previous state without adding the layer again.
Close and reopen Display Settings to see the restored Show linked sites state on the same layer.
screenshotCaptions: Display Settings shows Show linked sites checked for the loaded Surveyor - Service layer.
After the second selection, Show linked sites is checked again while Surveyor - Service remains loaded.
After closing and reopening Display Settings, Show linked sites is checked for the same Surveyor - Service layer.
guideUpdate.reason: Amend the existing Show linked sites guidance to explain changing and restoring the setting without re-adding the Surveyor layer and confirming the restored state when Display Settings is reopened.
